 WHEREAS 
 
 The Developer is the owner of a real estate project named and styled as ‘ ZAMEEN OPAL ’ consisting of residential apartments located at Plot No. 16 and 17, Land Breeze Society, Raiwind Road, Lahore (“ Project ”); 
 
 The Buyer has seen the Project and desires to purchase the fully constructed apartment together with all the White Goods , as more fully described in the Description of Purchased Unit and Appendix C ( together with the “ Purchased Unit ”) ; and 
 
 The Developer has agreed to sell , and the Buyer has agree d to purchase, the Purchased Unit on the terms and conditions of this Agreement to Sell. 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree to the following terms and conditions: 
 
 SCOPE AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 For the consideration provided in this Agreement to Sell (defined below), including without limitation the full Purchase Price, the Developer agrees to sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer, and the Buyer agrees to purchase the Purchased Unit from the Developer, along with all rights, title and interest s of the Developer therein , strictly in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement along with all documents attached hereto, as may be amended from time to time. Provided that where there is more than one person or entity as the “Buyer”, then the obligations of the persons or entities in relation hereto shall be joint and several. 
 
 The following documents (duly acknowledged) together shall constitute the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parties hereto in respect of the sale and purchase of the Purchased Unit, all of which shall form an integral part of the Agreement (the “Agreement” ): 
 
 This Agreement to Sell; 
 Schedule A: Description of Purchased Unit &amp; Nominees Form ; 
 Schedule B: General Terms and Conditions hereof ; 
 License Agreement; 
 A ppendix A : Payment Plan; 
 Appendix B: Purchased Unit Floor Plan; 
 Appendix C: Inventory of White Goods ; and 
 Any other document forming part of the Agreement by reference herein pursuant to the terms and conditions thereof. 
 
 The documents enumerated in Clause 2 above shall be taken as mutually explanatory, and in the event of any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy, unless otherwise specified, priority shall be given to the General Terms and Conditions, followed by the Payment Plan, and Description of Purchased Unit. Any terms used as defined terms shall have the meaning assigned to them in the General Terms and Conditions. The rules of interpretation set out in the General Terms and Conditions shall apply to all documents forming the Agreement. 
 
 BUYER’S WARRANTIES 
 
 The Buyer confirms having read, understood and agrees to comply with the Agreement at all times and by any further terms and conditions as may be prescribed from time to time by the Developer . 
 
 The Buyer represents and warrants that all details provided by the Buyer in this Agreement are true and correct in all respects. 
 
 The Buyer represents and warrants that the Buyer (and where there is more than one Buyer, each such Buyer) has the requisite capacity and authority to enter into the Agreement and to perform the obligations hereunder. 
 
 ARBITRATION 
 
 Any dispute or difference as to the Agreement or any part thereof or any matter or thing of whatsoever nature arising thereunder or in relation thereto between the Developer and the Buyer that cannot be resolved through mutual agreement shall be referred to arbitration in accordance with the General Terms and Conditions.

 SCHEDULE B 
 GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 
 
 DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION 
 Unless inconsistent with the context, the following words will have the meanings assigned below: 
 
 Agreement means the Agreement to Sell, including these General Terms and Conditions as well as all documents enumerated in Clause 2 of the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Agreement to Sell means the Agreement to Sell entered into between the Developer and the Buyer to which these General Terms and Conditions are appended. 
 
 Buyer means the person or persons identified as the Buyer in the Agreement to Sell and his/her or their respective heirs, executors, administrators, successors, permitted transferees and permitted assigns. Where there is more than one Buyer, references to one Buyer shall be to such persons jointly and severally. 
 
 Common Areas means those parts of the Project not physically forming a part of any Purchased Unit and are intended for the common use of all occupants or owners of all Purchased Units, including inter alia all open areas, elevators, administrative office areas, security system, lobbies, Parking Space and hallways. 
 
 Common Facilities means all roads, pavements, water features, installations, elevators, power backup equipment, security systems , tube-well motors, improvements and common assets of the Common Areas that are intended for facilitating all occupants and owners of Purchased Units and do not form part of any given Purchased Unit. 
 
 Competent Authority means any federal, provincial, capital or local government or authority, department, local, regulatory, statutory or housing authority and any other authority which has jurisdiction over any aspect or part of the Project or the Agreement. 
 
 Developer means D EEVAR DEVELOP ERS (PRIVATE) LIMITED , with its registered office at 94 B/I, M. M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore. 
 
 Down Payment means the down payment paid by the Buyer under the Agreement to Sell, as given in the Payment Plan or any other amount as agreed between the Parties in writing . 
 
 Due Date means the date on or before which any payment, including the payments mentioned in the Payment Plan, is required to be paid by the Buyer in the Developer’s designated bank account. 
 
 Event of Force Majeure has the meaning assigned to it in Clause REF _Ref98336344 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 14.1 of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Instalment Payment means any payment (including Down Payment) to be made by the Buyer as per the Payment Plan. 
 
 License has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 5 . 1. 
 
 Management Company means the entity or entities, which may include the Developer, any of its affiliates or associated companies or any other company (and their respective successors in interest and assigns) charged with the responsibility of maintaining, operating or managing the Project or any part thereof, including, inter alia, the Parking Space, Common Areas and/or Common Facilities. 
 
 Nominee means next of kin or any other person nominated by the Buyer in Schedule A to facilitate in the process of transfer of rights and obligations of the Buyer, under the Agreement to Sell and/or with respect to the Purchased Unit, to the Buyer’s legal heirs, in the event of demise of the Buyer. 
 
 Parking Space means the parking space allocated for the exclusive use of the Buyer or occupants of the Purchased Unit . 
 
 Party refers to either one of the parties to this Agreement , whereas Parties refers to both. 
 
 Payment Plan means the Payment Plan in A ppendix A of the Agreement to Sell , setting out the Due Date, quantum and schedule of Installment Payments of the Purchase Price to be paid by the Buyer to the Developer . 
 
 Permitted Use means the permi tted nature and use of the Purchased Unit as a residential unit , strictly in accordance with the Rules (defined below) . 
 
 Project means the real estate project , named and styled as ‘ Zameen Opal ’, constructed and developed by the Developer at Plot No. 16 and 17, Land Breeze Society, Raiwind Road, Lahore . 
 
 Purchase Price means the total amount payable by the Buyer to purchase the Purchased Unit (exclusive of tax ) including White Goods (as specified in Appendix C ), in the manner and such instalments, as identified in the Payment Plan in Appendix A to the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Purchased Unit means the fully constructed unit specifically described in Schedule A and shown in the Purchased Unit Floor Plan, including White Goods, which the Buyer has contracted to purchase pursuant to the Agreement. 
 
 Purchased Unit Floor 
 Plan means the floor plan of the Purchased Unit and its location, as shown in Appendix B to the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Rules means such rules as may be framed by the Developer and/or the Management Company and amended from time to time setting out the Buyer’s (or anyone occupying the Purchased Unit other than the Buyer) rights and obligations in relation to the transfer/resale, use, occupancy, layout, maintenance, design and display of the Purchased Units. 
 
 Service Charges Advance means the Service Charges payable by the Buyer to the Management Company in advance on or before the date of grant of License under Clause 5 of the General Terms and Conditions . 
 
 Service Charges m eans the amount payable by the Buyer or occupants , in the designated bank account of the Management Company from time to time, for the use and upkeep of Common Areas, Common Facilities, and/or Parking Space s of the Project . 
 White Goods means the household appliances provided in the Purchased Unit(s) as specified in Appendix C.

 An obligation on a Party to do any act, matter or thing includes an obligation to procure that it is done and words placing a Party under a restriction include an obligation not to permit or allow infringement of the restriction.

 SALE OF PURCHASED UNIT 
 
 2.1 The Developer agrees to sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer, and the Buyer agrees to purchase the Purchased Unit from the Developer, along with all rights, title and interest of the Developer therein, for a total sale consideration equal to the Purchase Price strictly in accordance with the Agreement and the terms and conditions thereof. 
 
 2.2 The Buyer acknowledges and understands that only rights, title and interests in and to the Purchased Unit shall be transferred and conveyed to the Buyer, and the Buyer shall have no rights, title or interest s in and to any other part of the Project other than the limited access to Common Areas, Common Facilities and Parking Space as expressly provided herein. For the avoidance of doubt, the Developer shall at all times have all rights, title and interest s with respect to the Common Areas, Common Facilities, Parking Space, roof and exterior walls. 
 
 BUYER’S OBLIGATIONS 
 
 The sale and transfer o f right s , title and interest s in and to the Purchased Unit , and handing over of possession thereof, in favour of the Buyer and uninterrupted enjoyment of all amenities and facilities in relation thereto, shall be subject to the following: 
 Payment of each Instalment Payment by the Buyer on or before the relevant Due Date; 
 Payment of one - time Service Charges Advance by the Buyer as and when due ; 
 Payment of Service Charges to the Management Company as per applicable rates and due dates specified by the Management Company. The Developer will endeavour to make all reasonable efforts to determine Service Charges as per fair market rates ; 
 Payment by the Buyer of all, electricity, water, or other utility and meter connection and consumption charges, as and when due . In the event that any utilities are provided to the Buyer directly by the Management Company, such amounts will be in addition to the Service Charges or Service Charges Advance and the Buyer shall settle any such charges as per consumption or usage promptly when required to do so ; 
 Payment by the Buyer of all applicable taxes, fees, stamp duties, and levies (if any) related to the Purchased Unit as per Clause 4 below ; and 
 The Buyer agrees to abide by all Rules and all other rules or regulations prescribed by any Competent Authority as may be applicable with respect to the Purchased Unit. 
 
 The Buyer understands and agree s that the Purchase Price does not include any costs associated with the transferring and recording of any rights in the Purchased Unit in the name of the Buyer, including the registration and stamping of the sale /purchase documentation or any other fee or charge (if any) which shall be payable separately by the Buyer. 
 The Buyer shall pay each Instalment Payment on its Due Date or within thirty (30) days thereof , without any deduction on account of bank charges, bank transfer charges, conversion cost, exchange rate fluctuations or otherwise, all of which shall be borne by the Buyer. The Instalment Payment shall be deposited by the Buyer in the Developer’s designated account given below, unless otherwise specified by the Developer to the Buyer in writing or via email, on or before the relevant Due Date. 
 By crossed cheque or bank draft in favour of “D EEVAR DEVELOPERS (PVT) LTD ” ;

 In addition to the Service Charges, it is understood by the Buyer that various Common Facilities and Common Areas may require repair or replacement to ensure continued enjoyment of the same by the Buyer/occupants , which shall be charged to Buyers at fair market prices, as may be notified to the Buyer and shall be required to be paid within the time stipulated by the Management Company. 
 
 3.6 The Buyer acknowledges and agrees that any payments made by the Buyer under this Agreement shall be utilised, in order of precedence, towards late payment charges (if any), any charges or expenses borne by the Developer in relation to the enforcement of this Agreement, and lastly the relevant Instalment Payment due along with any applicable taxes. 
 
 TAXES 
 
 The Buyer shall be solely responsible for all taxes, duties, transfer fees, rates, assessments, utilities and other charges with respect to the Purchased Unit. To the extent any payment of any such taxes, transfer fees, rates, assessments, utilities or other charges are paid by the Developer, in the Developer’s absolute discretion, on behalf of the Buyer the same shall be reimbursed by the Buyer as and when demanded by the Developer . 
 
 The Buyer agrees to pay all taxes and assessments in respect of the Purchased Unit from the date of grant of License under Clause 5 . 
 
 GRANT OF LICENSE 
 
 T he Developer shall grant to the Buyer a revocable License to use the Purchased Unit (“ License ") subject to the Buyer’s fulfilment of the following criteria: 
 
 Deposit of at least fifty percent (50%) of the Purchase Price in clear funds by the Buyer in the Developer’s bank account ; 
 Issuance of p ost-dated cheques in original in favour of the Developer, with an unconditional right to encash them, as a promise to pay in future the remaining I nstalment Payments as per the Payment Plan ; 
 Payment of the one-time Service Charge Advance to the Developer ; and 
 Payment of facilitation charges to the Developer for installation of electricity or other utility meter connection s . 
 
 Upon fulfilment of the criteria given in Clause 5.1 above, the Buyer shall execute a license agreement (“ License Agreement ") with the Developer, after which the Developer shall issue a license certificate in favour of the Buyer subject to the terms and conditions of the License Agreement. The Buyer acknowledges and agrees to be bound by all the terms and conditions of the License Agreement prescribed therein . 
 
 The Developer shall, to the extent possible, assign to the Buyer the benefit of any valid manufacturers’ warranties at the date of grant of the License , in respect of any White Goods provided in the Purchased Unit under this Agreement. The Developer makes no independent representation or warranty in this regard, including with respect to the fitness for use or quality of any White Goods and has relied on the manufacturers’/suppliers’ representations and warranties in this regard. The maintenance and/or replacement of all White Goods in the Purchased Unit shall be covered by the warranties of respective manufacturers issued at the time of purchase of the same, and the Developer shall have no liability thereof including but not limited to any extension in the warranty periods. 
 
 POSSESSION OF THE PURCHASED UNIT 
 
 On the completion of the Payment Plan, subject to the terms of this Agreement, the Developer shall transfer the title and physical possession of the Purchased Unit to the Buyer and issue the allotment letter in favour of the Buyer. For the sake of clarity, it is stated that upon issuance of the allotment letter the License Agreement and revocable license granted therein shall cease to exist. 
 
 The Developer shall render all reasonable assistance to the Buyer, including the issuance of NOC for recording of Buyer’s rights in the Purchased Unit in the relevant department / revenue record, if requested by the Buyer. For the avoidance of doubt, recording of the Buyer’s rights in the relevant department / revenue record shall be at the discretion and cost of the Buyer. 
 
 The Developer shall not be obliged to transfer the title of the Purchased Unit where the Buyer is not in compliance with his obligations under the Agreement.

 TRANSFER AND RESALE BY THE BUYER 
 
 In the event that after transfer and possession of the Purchased Unit in favour of the Buyer under Clause 6 , the Buyer intends to sell the Purchased Unit to any other person (hereinafter referred to as the “ Third Party ” for the purpose of this Clause REF _Ref98340729 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 8 .1 ), the sale of the Purchased Unit to such Third Party shall not be permitted unless a NOC for sale is obtained by the Buyer from the Developer in advance, upon obtaining which all rights, title and interest in the Purchased Unit may be transferred from the Buyer to the Third Party in the relevant department / revenue record / land registry (if required), costs whereof will be in addition to any applicable transfer charges. The Buyer shall ensure that such Third Party does and executes all such acts, deeds and things as required by the Developer or under law for the sale, transfer and conveyance of the Purchased Unit . 
 
 T he Buyer agrees and acknowledges that, prior to the possession and allotment of the Purchased Unit to t he Buyer under Clause 6 , no sale, assignment, transfer, lease or other disposition of any interest in the Purchase d Unit in favour of any third party (hereinafter referred to as the “Transfer” for the purpose of this Clause 8.2 ) shall be valid unless: 
 
 an amount equal to fifty percent (50%) of the Purchase Price has been paid by the Buyer to the Developer in clear funds ; 
 all payments due under the Payment Plan have been made by the Buyer; 
 the Buyer is not in breach of any of the terms of the License granted under Clause 5; 
 the Buyer obtains an NOC from the Developer for the Transfer and completes all necessary documentation required ; 
 t ransfer charges of one percent (1%) of the Purchase Price, along with all fees, relevant Taxes, duties, and charges (including stamp duties and registration charges) or any other applicable fee have been paid in respect of the Transfer by the Buyer ; 
 a ll payments due as at the proposed date of the Transfer, including any Service Charges, have been paid in full to the Developer , Management Company and any Competent Authorities to their satisfaction.; and 
 t he transferee to the Purchased Unit has agreed and undertaken in writing to be bound by th e Agreement, the agreement with the Management Company, and has signed a letter of adherence (or such other document) in relation thereto as may be prescribed by the Developer and/or the Management Company with respect to the Transfer . 
 
 The Buyer understands and acknowledges that there may be additional terms and conditions applicable with respect to the Transfer from time to time and the Buyer shall be responsible for reviewing and informing himself of the process of Transfer from the Developer before initiating such Transfer . 
 
 The Developer may assign or otherwise transfer its rights and obligations under the Agreement or with respect to the Project to any person or party, without giving any notice to the Buyer, and the Buyer hereby consents to any such assignment or transfer. 
 PARKING SPACE 
 The Developer will allocate one (1) Parking Space to the Buyer with respect to the Purchased Unit, the exact location of which shall be identified by the Developer upon grant of the License . The Buyer acknowledges that the Buyer only has permission to access and use the Parking Space and has no legal rights, title and/or interest in the allocated Parking Space , except to the extent specified in this Clause 9 and/or the right to transfer or sub-let or otherwise dispose of the Parking Space. 
 MODIFICATIONS TO THE PURCHASED UNIT 
 
 The Buyer understands and acknowledges that any modification to the Purchased Unit shall not be permitted without the prior written approval of the Management Company or the Developer. 
 
 The Buyer agrees to comply with and adhere to the Rules governing the modifications to the Purchased Unit. Any failure of the Buyer to comply with these Rules shall result in penalties, fines, or other consequences as specified by the Management Company. The Developer reserves the right to inspect and approve any modifications made by the Buyer in accordance with the Rules. 
 
 DEFAULT BY THE BUYER AND DEFAULTING PENALTY 
 
 If the Buyer fails to pay any Instalment Payment or other payments , including but not limited to any taxes under Clause 4, due under the Agreement to the Developer, the Management Company or to any Competent Authority, within thirty (30) days of its Due Date, then the Developer may impose late payment charges at the rate of two percent (2%) per month from the Due Date on each outstanding Instalment Payment or any part thereof and/or any other payment(s) that remain(s) outstanding. Delay in payment of any payment due under the Agreement by the Buyer exceeding sixty (60) days from the relevant Due Date shall be treated as a material default by the Buyer and the Developer will be entitled to take action in accordance with Clause 1 2 below. 
 
 In the event of noncompliance or default by the Buyer on payment of the remaining Instalment Payments or any other payment or condition as prescribed in the License Agreement , the Developer shall have absolute right and entitlement to revoke the License under Clause 12. For the sake of clarity, the revocation of the License by the Developer shall automatically revoke the sublicense granted by the Buyer (if any). 
 
 Joint Buyers shall, jointly and individually, be responsible to fulfil and discharge all the obligations hereinabove mentioned. Upon breach of any of the conditions of the Agreement by any one or all of them, the Developer may resort to any legal means, in terms of the breach, against any one or all of the joint Buyers (as the Developer may determine in its sole discretion). 
 
 The Parties hereby agree and acknowledge that the late payment charges stated in the Agreement do not constitute a penalty and are a genuine pre-estimate of the losses suffered by the Developer . 
 
 TERMINATION AND CANCELLATION OF SALE 
 
 In the event that the Buyer has failed to fulfil its payment obligations under Clause REF _Ref98257841 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 11 of the Agreement (including payment of late payment charges ), the Developer may serve a written notice of default to the Buyer for not less than seven (7) days. The Buyer shall be under an obligation to remedy the default within the time stipulated in the notice of default. U pon termination , all Instalment Payments paid by the Buyer shall be refunded in accordance with Clause REF _Ref98258051 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 1 3 .2 and subject to deductions specified therein. For the avoidance of doubt, no payment from the Buyer shall be accepted after the date of termination, however, in the event the Buyer deposits a payment after the date of termination it shall be refunded in accordance with Clause REF _Ref98258051 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 1 3 .2 . 
 
 Subject to the terms and conditions of the Agreement, the Developer may at any time terminate the Agreement in the event that any statement, representation, warranty or information provided by the Buyer to the Developer under this Agreement is found to be incorrect or false by serving a notice in writing to the Buyer. Upon termination , all Instalment Payments paid by the Buyer shall be refunded in accordance with Clause REF _Ref98258051 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 1 3 .2 and subject to such deductions as specified therein. 
 
 Subject to the terms and conditions of the Agreement, either Party may terminate the Agreement at any time with immediate effect , by notifying the other Party in writing in accordance with Clause REF _Ref98257940 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 1 7 .1 below . 
 
 The Buyer understands, acknowledges and confirms that upon the termination of the Agreement for any reason whatsoever, the Buyer shall have no rights, title, claim, benefit or interest with respect to the Purchased Unit on and from the date of termination. 
 
 CONSEQUENCES OF TERMINATION 
 
 Subject to Clause 1 3 . 3 , upon termination of the Agreement, any refund of payments due to the Buyer shall be paid: 
 
 If the Agreement is terminated under Clause REF _Ref98257815 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 12.1 or REF _Ref98257828 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 12.2 , upon re-sale of the Purchased Unit; or 
 
 If the Agreement is terminated for any other reason whatsoever, within six (6) months of termination or upon re-sale of the Purchased Unit, whichever comes later . 
 
 Upon termination of the Agreement , refund of Instalment Payments by the Developer to the Buyer shall be subject to the following deductions: 
 cancellation charges equal to fifteen percent (15%) of the Purchase Price .; 
 Late payment charges due under Clause 1 1 above (if any); and 
 and any other adjustments, charge s or cost s payable by the Buyer under the Agreement (if any). 
 
 Provided that any refund shall be subject to deduction of any difference between the Purchase Price and the market price of the Purchased Unit (as determined by the Developer in its absolute discretion) at the time of termination hereof in the event that the latter is lower . 
 
 Provided further that i n the event of any shortfall, the Buyer shall be liable to pay the shortfall amount to the Developer without any delay whatsoever. 
 
 The Buyer agrees and acknowledges that it is the sole responsibility of the Buyer to collect the refund under Clause 12 from the Developer’s office during office hours and that the Developer shall not in any manner whatsoever be liable in this regard including inter alia with respect to any delay or failure on the part of the Buyer to collect the refund. 
 
 FORCE MAJEURE 
 
 “Event of Force Majeure” means any event or occurrence beyond the control of the Developer (including but not limited to any injunction/stay order, government notification, or spread of infectious disease on the Project site) that prevents the Developer from completing or performing its obligations under the Agreement. The Developer shall not be liable for such non-completion or non-performance under the Agreement for so long as such Event of Force Majeure exists and its effects continue. 
 
 No Event of Force Majeure which is less than thirty (30) calendar days shall ex empt the Buyer from making any Instalment Payment on its Due Date. Any Event of Force Majeure exceeding thirty (30) days shall result in a commensurate adjustment of the Due Date of any remaining Instalment Payments. 
 
 ENTIRE AGREEMENT 
 
 The Agreement, as defined in Clause REF _Ref98341267 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 2 of the Agreement to Sell, constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties and overrides, supersedes, cancels any other negotiations, commitments, discussions, representations, warranties, conditions or collateral agreements, express or implied, written or oral, whether made by the Developer, any officer, agent, employee or representative of the Developer or any other person including, without limitation, arising out of any marketing material including sales brochures, models, representative view sets, showroom displays, photographs, videos, illustrations, renderings, revenue projections or pro-forma statements provided to the Buyer or made available for his/her viewing and, upon acceptance by the Developer, the Agreement shall form a binding agreement subject only to the terms and conditions contained therein. 
 
 Except as contemplated in the Agreement, any modification or amendment to the Agreement shall be in writing duly signed by both Parties. 
 
 GOVERNING LAW AND ARBITRATION 
 
 The Agreement shall be governed and construed according to the laws of Pakistan and subject to clause REF _Ref98258210 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 16.2 , the Courts at Lahore shall have exclusive jurisdiction. 
 
 Any dispute between the Parties arising out of or with respect to the Agreement will be resolved amicably between the Parties within fifteen (15) days of its so arising, failing which it shall be referred to and settled by arbitration under the Arbitration Act, 1940. After the lapse of fifteen (15) days, arbitration proceedings may be initiated by delivery of a notice in writing by either Party to the other Party. The arbitration panel shall consist of three arbitrators: one to be appointed by each Party and a third to be appointed mutually by the first two arbitrators. The place of arbitration shall be Lahore and the language of the arbitration proceedings shall be English. The decision and award of the arbitrator(s), as the case may be, shall be final, non-appealable and binding on both Parties, including decisions as to costs. 
 
 NOTICES 
 
 Without prejudice to the right to serve notice by any other means, any notice required to be served under the Agreement shall be in writing in the English language and shall be deemed sufficiently served forty-eight (48) hours after it has been mailed by registered post or twenty-four (24) hours if served through e-mail, to the address of the Party to be served that is set out in the Agreement to Sell or to such other address of which a notice has been previously given by the Party. It is clarified that in the case there is more than one Buyer, notice to any one Buyer shall be deemed as notice to all Buyers . 
 
 The Buyer shall notify the Developer in writing, in advance, of any change of address (postal, email, or otherwise). Buyer’s failure to report a change of address shall not affect the validity of service of any notice that may be served by the Developer to the Buyer at the last known address. 
 
 SURVIVAL 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges and agrees that the Agreement will survive the transfer of the Purchased Unit in the name of the Buyer and any subsequent buyer. The Agreement shall ensure to the benefit of and be binding upon the Parties hereto and their respective personal representatives, heirs, successors, and permitted assigns. 
 
 The Developer agrees that in case of the death of the Buyer, the Developer shall make reasonable efforts to assist the Nominee named by the Buyer to procure the succession of the legal heirs to the rights of the Buyer under the Agreement, in accordance with the requirements of applicable laws of inheritance. 
 
 INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY 
 
 The Developer may alter the name or logo of the Project at any time at its sole discretion without any notice to the Buyer. 
 
 The Developer shall own and retain all rights , title and interest in and to all and any work product, patent, trademarks, Confidential Information, logo, brand name, trade secret or other data or any other intellectual property of the Developer and nothing in this Agreement shall be deemed to constitute a grant of any license or other right to or in respect thereof. 
 
 TIME IS OF THE ESSENCE 
 
 With respect to the payments to be made by the Buyer, time shall be of the essence under this Agreement, except to the extent of any cure periods or periods of delay envisaged in Clauses 1 2 and 22 under this Agreement . 
 
 LIMITATION OF LIABILITY 
 
 Any liability of the Developer arising under or in relation to this Agreement, whether arising under contractual laws, tort or otherwise, shall under no circumstances whatsoever, exceed five per cent (5%) of the total payment(s) received by the Developer from the Buyer. 
 
 WAIVER 
 
 No right or remedy conferred upon or reserved by the Developer under this Agreement is intended to be or shall be deemed to be exclusive of any other right or remedy herein or by law or equity provided or permitted, but each such right or remedy shall be cumulative of every other right or remedy. The Developer’s failure or delay in exercising any right, power or privilege under this Agreement will not operate as a waiver thereof . 
 
 SEVERABILITY 
 
 If any one or more provisions of the Agreement or any part thereof are declared or adjudged to be illegal or invalid or unenforceable under any applicable law, such illegality, invalidity or unenforceability shall not invalidate the other provisions herein, which shall remain in full force and effect, and the Parties shall, within thirty (30) days of such declaration or judgment, substitute the affected provisions in such a way that, to the maximum extent possible, the substitution carries out the original intent of the Parties as to the point or points in question . 
 
 CONFIDENTIALITY 
 
 The existence and the terms and conditions of this Agreement and any documents, data, notices or information disclosed or shared by the Developer, oral or written, shall be regarded as confidential information by the Buyer and the Buyer shall take all reasonable measures to maintain the confidentiality of all such confidential information and shall not disclose any such confidential information to any third parties, except where such disclosure is required under any law or court order. This clause shall survive the termination or expiry of this Agreement. 
 GOOD FAITH 
 
 Each Party shall in good faith perform their obligations under the Agreement based on confidence placed by such Party in the other and thereon relied upon by such Party. 
 
 COUNTERPARTS 
 
 The Agreement may be executed, accepted and delivered in two counterparts, both of which shall together constitute the same Agreement. 
 
 ACKNOWLEDGEMENT 
 
 The Buyer hereby confirms having read, understood and accepted the Agreement in its entirety and is affixing his/her signature in the presence of witnesses.
